findings.title: Missing await on async fetch_rate call
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but it is called without `await`, so the function will return a coroutine object instead of the expected `Decimal` rate. Add `await` to line 16 to properly await the rate.

findings.title: Multiplication of int and coroutine object
findings.body: Line 17 multiplies `amount_cents` (an `int`) by `rate` (a coroutine object due to the missing `await` on line 16). This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime. Fix the await on line 16 first.

summary.problem: The new `converted_cents` function calls an async function without await, causing a runtime error.
summary.done_well: The function signature and docstring clearly describe the intended behavior and parameter types.
